day5_ending_true.name: Me
day5_ending_true.text: *And so, my transfer student story comes to an end.*

day5_ending_true_2.name: Me
day5_ending_true_2.text: *That one person I met at my new school.*

day5_ending_true_3.name: Me
day5_ending_true_3.text: *From the very first moment we met, until this very moment— my heart never once wavered.*

day5_ending_true_4.name: Me
day5_ending_true_4.text: *I remember it. That moment our eyes first met in the hallway. It felt like time had stopped.*

day5_ending_true_5.name: Me
day5_ending_true_5.text: *I didn't know back then. That one brief glance would change the course of my entire life.*

day5_ending_true_6.name: Me
day5_ending_true_6.text: *I can't pinpoint the exact moment I fell in love. I just— one day, I couldn't imagine a tomorrow without them.*

day5_ending_true_7.name: Me
day5_ending_true_7.text: *Like warmth that still lingers on my lips, this feeling will never fade.*

day5_ending_true_8.name: Me
day5_ending_true_8.text: *Some would say even feelings like this have an expiration date.*

day5_ending_true_9.name: Me
day5_ending_true_9.text: *But I know the truth. This isn't something that cools— it's something that seeps deeper.*

day5_ending_true_10.name: Me
day5_ending_true_10.text: *Tomorrow, the day after, even a year from now I can see myself unable to escape from this person.*

day5_ending_true_11.name: Me
day5_ending_true_11.text: *Let's make a promise. No matter what season comes, you will be tied to my side forever.*

day5_ending_true_12.name: Me
day5_ending_true_12.text: *To love someone completely is to hold one single obsession amid all the uncertainty in the world.*

day5_ending_good.name: Me
day5_ending_good.text: *And so, my transfer student story comes to an end.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_2.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_2.text: *It took me a long time to find the courage. But because I waited, this feeling is certain.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_3.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_3.text: *My heart was set from the beginning. It just took time to put it into words.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_4.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_4.text: *I hesitated because I was afraid of the answer. Afraid of rejection, afraid of ruining what we had.*

day5_ending_good_faithful_5.name: Me
day5_ending_good_faithful_5.text: *But I finally said it. And the answer— was worth the wait.*

day5_ending_good_2.name: Me
day5_ending_good_2.text: *My heart swayed at times, and I made mistakes.*

day5_ending_good_3.name: Me
day5_ending_good_3.text: *But in the end— I found where my true feelings belonged.*

day5_ending_good_4.name: Me
day5_ending_good_4.text: *Looking back, there were times I was careless with someone else's heart.*

day5_ending_good_5.name: Me
day5_ending_good_5.text: *I may have given someone hope only to take it away. I'm sorry for that.*

day5_ending_good_6.name: Me
day5_ending_good_6.text: *But it was because of that wavering that I came to understand what true feelings really are.*

day5_ending_good_7.name: Me
day5_ending_good_7.text: *It doesn't have to be perfect. Because this is our beginning.*

day5_ending_good_8.name: Me
day5_ending_good_8.text: *I wasn't lost. It was just a process to make you mine.*

day5_ending_good_9.name: Me
day5_ending_good_9.text: *If there had been no hesitation, there would be no such terrible possessiveness now.*

day5_ending_good_10.name: Me
day5_ending_good_10.text: *Imperfect love is still love. No perhaps it's more perfect because it's broken.*

day5_ending_good_11.name: Me
day5_ending_good_11.text: *I'll make mistakes again. We'll clash. But with this person, falling into ruin together wouldn't be so bad.*

day5_ending_good_12.name: Me
day5_ending_good_12.text: *So it's okay. This obsession took a long time to form that's exactly why it will never be undone.*

day5_ending_mayhem.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem.text: *And so, my transfer student story… is it really over?*

day5_ending_mayhem_2.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_2.text: *The night sky was too beautiful to gaze at just one star.*

day5_ending_mayhem_3.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_3.text: *…not that excuses like that will stop them from chasing me.*

day5_ending_mayhem_4.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_4.text: *One day, three lunch boxes appeared behind the classroom at the same time. That day, I genuinely thought I was done for.*

day5_ending_mayhem_5.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_5.text: ("Is she your girlfriend?" "No, I am!" "What are you talking about, it's me!" …The hallway became a battlefield that day.)

day5_ending_mayhem_6.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_6.text: *I took the chance to sneak away to the rooftop. I'd never run that fast in my entire life.*

day5_ending_mayhem_7.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_7.text: *…But someone was already waiting for me on the rooftop. There really was no escape.*

day5_ending_mayhem_8.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_8.text: *Maybe it's selfish. Wanting to cherish everyone. But it's already too late.*

day5_ending_mayhem_9.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_9.text: *Their obsession is already suffocating me. The moment I choose one, I will be ruined.*

day5_ending_mayhem_10.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_10.text: *Honestly, this hellish daily life... isn't so bad. I wonder what chaos tomorrow will bring.*

day5_ending_mayhem_11.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_11.text: *Would I make the same choices if I were born again? …I won't answer that. But this smile is real.*

day5_ending_mayhem_12.name: Me
day5_ending_mayhem_12.text: *There's no conclusion. But well… this chaotic everyday life is my story.*

day5_ending_harem.name: Me
day5_ending_harem.text: *And so, my transfer student story— hasn't ended.*

day5_ending_harem_2.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_2.text: *Multiple lovers. An impossible reality unfolded before my eyes.*

day5_ending_harem_3.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_3.text: *Every day is a war. Battles break out daily over who gets treated the best.*

day5_ending_harem_4.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_4.text: *Mondays: who walks me to school. Tuesdays: whose lunch I eat. Wednesdays: who walks me home... My weekly schedule is a diplomatic nightmare.*

day5_ending_harem_5.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_5.text: *One of them watches over me with a quiet smile, another confidently links her arm with mine, and the last one secretly holds my hand from behind.*

day5_ending_harem_6.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_6.text: *Each of their charms is so different. That's why I can't compare them, and that's why I can't give any of them up.*

day5_ending_harem_7.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_7.text: *But oddly enough, all of them are smiling. As if they completely own me.*

day5_ending_harem_8.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_8.text: *Call it greed if you want. If I can't escape from this terrible cycle of obsession.*

day5_ending_harem_9.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_9.text: *No regrets. No, they don't even give me time to regret. They are watching my every move.*

day5_ending_harem_10.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_10.text: *Of course, no one knows when this balance will break. The moment someone crosses the line, a bloodbath will begin.*

day5_ending_harem_11.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_11.text: *But the fact that I even enjoy the tension— maybe I'm already past the point of no return.*

day5_ending_harem_12.name: Me
day5_ending_harem_12.text: *Tomorrow I'll be watched again. The day after, they'll tighten their grip even more. But these bloody days, I accept them.*

day5_ending_friend.name: Me
day5_ending_friend.text: *And so, my transfer student story comes to an end.*

day5_ending_friend_2.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_2.text: *I couldn't say what I felt. No— I chose not to.*

day5_ending_friend_3.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_3.text: (The feelings I hid behind the word "friend" might surface on some quiet nights.)

day5_ending_friend_4.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_4.text: *I remember. That day on the rooftop, the way the wind swept their hair, and the fingertips that brushed it aside.*

day5_ending_friend_5.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_5.text: (If I had said "I like you" back then, would tonight be any different?)

day5_ending_friend_6.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_6.text: *Unspoken feelings don't disappear. They simply glow quietly, deep within the heart.*

day5_ending_friend_7.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_7.text: (Sometimes the closest distance is also the farthest. The distance called "friends.")

day5_ending_friend_8.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_8.text: *Still, it's not all bad. I can see their smile right beside me. Waiting for the day I can shatter that smile.*

day5_ending_friend_9.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_9.text: *Maybe this isn't cowardice, but a quiet hunt. Staying by their side while holding my prey.*

day5_ending_friend_10.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_10.text: *Still I don't regret it. Someday, the chance to make you completely mine will come.*

day5_ending_friend_11.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_11.text: *Someday— when the day comes that I can speak this heart, I won't hesitate.*

day5_ending_friend_12.name: Me
day5_ending_friend_12.text: *Some stories linger longer precisely because they're left unfinished. This season will be remembered that way.*

day5_ending_alone.name: Me
day5_ending_alone.text: *And so, my transfer student story comes to an end.*

day5_ending_alone_2.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_2.text: *No one special came along. But the time I spent at this school was precious.*

day5_ending_alone_3.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_3.text: *I'm different now from who I was before I transferred— back when I felt like I couldn't do anything.*

day5_ending_alone_4.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_4.text: *What I learned at this school wasn't about romance. It was about facing myself.*

day5_ending_alone_5.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_5.text: *The laughter in the classroom, the chatter between classes, the sunlight during P.E.— all those ordinary things mattered.*

day5_ending_alone_6.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_6.text: *Solitude is not a punishment. It's time spent face to face with yourself.*

day5_ending_alone_7.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_7.text: *I learned that before you can love someone else, you must first understand yourself.*

day5_ending_alone_8.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_8.text: *Being alone doesn't mean being lonely. There are things you can only hear when you're on your own. Their footsteps, their breathing, the eyes watching me.*

day5_ending_alone_9.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_9.text: *The sound of the wind, my footsteps, my own heartbeat. Within that quiet rhythm, I was slowly going mad.*

day5_ending_alone_10.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_10.text: *Even if I couldn't reach anyone, these times are never meaningless. Because I am definitely sinking into a deeper darkness than yesterday.*

day5_ending_alone_11.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_11.text: *There's no need to rush. I can walk at my own pace, on my own path.*

day5_ending_alone_12.name: Me
day5_ending_alone_12.text: *Walking alone on a night road isn't so bad. The stars shine brightest, after all, because of the darkness.*
